senses.gloss: c. (b. h.; or <he>כנס</he>, v. Ges. Thes., a. Hebr. Dict.<sup>10</sup> s. v.)

units: <cite ref="Eruvin 65b">Erub. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>בג׳ … בכיסו בכוֹסוֹ בכעסו</he> man’s character is found out in three things, in his money bag, in his cup (when drinking) and in his anger; <cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Zuta 5">Der. Er. Zutta ch. V.—Keth. 75</cite><cite ref="Ketubot 75b">Keth. 75ᵇ</cite>, sq., v. <cite ref="B00154"><he>בָּדַק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 105a:10">Pes. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>קדושה על הכ׳</he> sanctification (of the Sabbath or Holy Day) over a cup of wine.
<cite ref="Pesachim 105a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>אם אין לו אלא כ׳ אחד</he> if he has only enough wine for one cup.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 14:3">Sabb. XIV, 3</cite> <he>כ׳ עיקרים</he>, v. <cite ref="P00666"><he>עִיקָּר</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כּוֹסוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 22:1">Kel. XXII, 1</cite>; Y. Ab. Zar. II, end, 42ᵃ, v. <cite ref="E00673"><he>הַנָּחָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:1">Pes. X, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>ארבע כ׳</he> four cups of wine to be drunk on the Passover night; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 2:5">Par. II, 5</cite> (two black or white hairs) <he>בתוך כ׳ אחד</he> in one follicle (v. <cite ref="C00995"><he>גוּמָּא</he></cite>).—Pl. as ab.
Ib. Y. Ab. Zar. l. c. הן כ׳ הן גומות kosoth and gummoth mean the same things.—בֵּית הכּוֹסוֹת the second stomach of ruminants.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Chullin 42a">42ᵃ</cite>), v. comment. a. <cite ref="E00045"><he>הַבְלִילָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 49a">Ḥull. 49ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 50b:11">50ᵇ</cite> <he>עובי בית הכ׳</he> the folds (thick walls) of the etc.; a. fr.
